'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kherson strikes (2022–present)|Kherson strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[artillery]] and [[glide bomb]]s target [[Kherson]], [[Ukraine]], killing one person and injuring nine others. A sports facility, a [[supermarket]], and [[residential building]]s were among those hit. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-kherson-glide-bombs-72f7bda22f4fb8c990a026d55f4ce66e (AP)]
**[[Dnipro strikes (2022–present)|Dnipro strikes]]
***A large-scale [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Dnipro]], [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], kills two people and injures 16 others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/mass-drone-attack-kills-one-injures-seven-ukraines-dnipro-governor-says-2025-04-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants capture the [[Adan Yabal District]] in [[Middle Shabelle]], [[Somalia]], as the group continues to advance towards the capital [[Mogadishu]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-shabaab-captures-strategic-somalia-town-it-presses-offensive-2025-04-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]]
**[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] and [[Attorney General of California|California Attorney General]] [[Rob Bonta]] file a lawsuit against [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|his administration]] over the [[tariff|tariffs]], making [[California]] the first [[U.S. state]] to do so. The lawsuit also targets the [[International Emergency Economic Powers Act|International Economic Emergency Powers Act]], the law used by Trump to impose tariffs against [[Canada]], [[China]], and [[Mexico]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2025/04/16/california-is-first-state-to-sue-trump-on-tariffs-00292637 (Politico)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Philippine Coast Guard|Authorities]] recover the remains of a [[Filipinos|Filipino]] crew member from the [[sand]] [[barge]] Hong Hai 16 that capsized off [[Occidental Mindoro]], [[Philippines]], yesterday, bringing the total death toll to two. Nine others are reportedly still missing. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/regions/942984/death-toll-of-capsized-ship-off-mindoro-now-2-pcg-searching-for-survivors/story/ (GMA News)]
*The HB Kongolo traveling from Matankumu to [[Bolomba]], carrying around 400 people, catches fire and [[Capsizing|capsizes]] on the [[Congo River]] near [[Mbandaka]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], killing at least 50 people and leaving hundreds more missing. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-boat-accident-fire-fb3aa610c4690348998803b3f3a1b50d (AP)]
*Three people are killed and two others are injured when two [[boat]]s collide on [[Lewis Smith Lake]] in [[Cullman County, Alabama|Cullman County]], [[Alabama]], United States, during a Major League Fishing tournament. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/alabama-boat-collision-smith-lake/story?id=120887192 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[United Kingdom]] suspends the import of [[cheese]] and [[meat]] products from the [[European Union]] to prevent the spread of [[foot-and-mouth disease]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2vpp8zzd7o (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Brazil–Peru relations]], Aftermath of the [[Operation Car Wash]]
**Following her sentencing to 15 years in prison, former [[First Lady of Peru]] [[Nadine Heredia]] and her son Samin flee to [[Brazil]]'s capital [[Brasília]] after the country grants their [[right of asylum]]. [https://apnews.com/article/peru-nadine-heredia-ollanta-humala-asylum-brazil-bfc9c4b0a8862bfb3bdb5aae04100808 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Democratic backsliding in Europe by country#Slovakia|Democratic backsliding in Slovakia]], [[2025 Slovak protests]]
**The [[Slovakia|Slovak]] [[Government of Slovakia|government]] passes a law requiring [[non-governmental organizations]] to disclose their [[funding]] sources and the names of major [[donor]]s. [[List of political parties in Slovakia|Opposition groups]] criticize the law as it could restrict [[civil society]] institutions. [https://www.dw.com/en/slovakia-passes-law-on-ngos-amid-criticism/a-72268853 (DW)] [https://www.politico.eu/article/slovakia-adopts-russian-bill-targeting-ngos/ (''Politico'')] 
*[[Israeli–Lebanese conflict]]
**The [[Lebanese military]] detains a group of people, including several [[Palestinians]], for firing [[rocket (weapon)|rocket]]s towards [[Israel]] in two separate attacks. [[Hezbollah]] denies their involvement in the rocket attacks. [https://apnews.com/article/lebanon-israel-rockets-palestinians-detained-hamas-7c2be638daa75ecc39e5c89515d616b7 (AP)]
*[[Transgender rights in the United Kingdom]], ''[[For Women Scotland Ltd v The Scottish Ministers]]''
** The [[Supreme Court of the United Kingdom]] rules that [[legal gender]] is based upon [[Sex|biological sex]] for the purposes of the [[Equality Act 2010]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvg7pqzk47zo (BBC News)]
*A [[Germany|German]] [[palliative care]] doctor is charged for allegedly [[Angel of mercy (criminology)|killing]] fifteen patients between 2021 and 2024 in [[Berlin]]. He is being investigated in an additional 75 suspected cases and also accused of trying to [[tampering with evidence|cover up the evidence]] by [[Arson|starting fires]] in their homes. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-palliative-doctor-patients-deaths-berlin-fires-637c1779ca95cd085d80cb76ab2e5c12 (AP)] [https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/regional/berlin/palliativarzt-mord-anklage-berlin-100.html (Tagesschau)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The leader of the [[Sudan]]ese [[Rapid Support Forces]], [[Hemedti|Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo]], announces the establishment of the [[Government of Peace and Unity]], a rival government to the country's [[Sudanese Armed Forces|armed forces]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgrgqjq8ynzo (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A research team at the [[University of Cambridge]] announces that the [[James Webb Space Telescope]] has detected [[dimethyl sulfide]], a chemical thought to be produced in nature only by [[Organism|living organisms]], on [[exoplanet]] [[K2-18b]], a [[sub-Neptune]] planet around 124 [[light-year]]s (38 [[parsec|pc]]) away from [[Earth]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c39jj9vkr34o (BBC News)]
*A [[colossal squid]] is filmed in the [[Southern Atlantic Ocean]] for the first time since the species was discovered in 1925. The {{cvt|30|cm|in|adj=on}}-long juvenile was filmed by a team of scientists led by the [[University of Essex]] near the [[South Sandwich Islands]] at a depth of {{cvt|600|m|ft|abbr=on}}. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c99pg13yv32o (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Women's World Chess Championship 2025]]
**[[Chess in China|Chinese]] [[Grandmaster (chess)|grandmaster]] [[Ju Wenjun]] wins her fifth consecutive [[Women's World Chess Championship]] title after defeating fellow Chinese grandmaster [[Tan Zhongyi]] with a score of 6.5–2.5. Ju becomes the first Chinese player to win the championship five times. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/04/17/sport/ju-wenjun-womens-world-chess-championship-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
